images.author: Niceckhart
images.caption: An ALCO store that was closed on April 29, 2013 in Vermilion, Ohio.

brief: A 1970s single-storey discount store: a long flat-roofed box with a white ribbed metal fascia carrying purple letters, a glazed front with a 'closing sale' banner, a car park. One photo. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: an Alco discount store (Vermilion OH, 1975) closing down: a plain painted-block box with a parapet sign band and a blue canopy on posts over the sidewalk, 'CLOSING SALE' signs; a wet parking lot

why.note: small discount chains closing: the dead box (reuse: dollar store, church, fulfilment)
